title: Adventureland
specs: Gas-powered go-karts with double cars for child/adult drivers
Bumper Boats with water sprayers for wet fun
Victorian-style carousel with unique animals and spinning cups
Go-Kart driver must be 16+ years old and 56" & 10 years to drive alone
Bumper Boats require minimum height 46"; Spin Zone minimum height 36"; Go-Karts minimum height 56" and age 10
All Go-Kart riders must wear seat belts; helmets available for double riders
Shoes must be worn on all rides including Bumper Boats, Go-Karts, Spin Zone
Group rates available for 30+ guests; call ahead
